notes.title: Countdown for lift off initiated
notes.content:
Hello Aviators!

We’re happy to announce that we’re nearing the point where the game is ready to go into Early Access here on Steam. Hopefully this will be at the end of next week.

The game will at this point feature:
Online gaming.
Team play 2v2, 3v3, 4v4.
Support for all major controls.

Strap yourself in for this flying extravaganza!

/Dev team

Please join the 501 Industries Steam group for all the latest news on all our games.
